} from 'lucide-react';

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dashboard');
  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState(15450.00);
  const [cashbackBalance, setCashbackBalance] = useState(320.50);
  const [showBalance, setShowBalance] = useState(true);
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [notificationsOpen, setNotificationsOpen] = useState(false);

  // Modals state
  const [fundWalletModal, setFundWalletModal] = useState(false);
  const [pinModal, setPinModal] = useState(false);
  const [receiptModal, setReceiptModal] = useState(null);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState(null);

  // Form States
  const [transactionType, setTransactionType] = useState(''); // 'data', 'airtime', 'cable', 'electricity', 'transfer'
  const [selectedNetwork, setSelectedNetwork] = useState('mtn');
  const [dataType, setDataType] = useState('SME');
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState(null);
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState('');
  const [airtimeAmount, setAirtimeAmount] = useState('');
  const [cableProvider, setCableProvider] = useState('dstv');
  const [smartCardNo, setSmartCardNo] = useState('');
  const [cablePlan, setCablePlan] = useState('');
  const [customerInfo, setCustomerInfo] = useState(null);
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = useState(false);
  const [discoProvider, setDiscoProvider] = useState('ikedc');
  const [meterType, setMeterType] = useState('prepaid');
  const [meterNo, setMeterNo] = useState('');
  const [electricityAmount, setElectricityAmount] = useState('');
  const [pinInput, setPinInput] = useState(['', '', '', '']);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  
  // Wallet Funding state
  const [fundAmount, setFundAmount] = useState('');
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState('bank');
  const [promoCode, setPromoCode] = useState('');
  const [copiedAccount, setCopiedAccount] = useState(null);

  // Filter state for transactions
  const [txSearch, setTxSearch] = useState('');
  const [txFilter, setTxFilter] = useState('all');

  // Initial Transactions
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState([
    {
      id: 'TRX-98234101',
      type: 'Data Purchase',
      details: 'MTN SME 5GB - 08031234567',
      network: 'mtn',
      amount: 1400,

      date: '2026-10-25 14:32',
      ref: 'TD-DATA-883921',
      recipient: '08031234567'
    },
    {

      type: 'Airtime Topup',
      details: 'Airtel VTU ₦1,000 - 08029876543',
      network: 'airtel',
      amount: 980,
      status: 'successful',
      date: '2026-10-24 09:15',
      ref: 'TD-AIR-110293',
      recipient: '08029876543'
    },
    {
      id: 'TRX-98233955',
      type: 'Wallet Top-up',
      details: 'Automated Moniepoint Deposit',
      network: 'wallet',
      amount: 10000,
      status: 'successful',
      date: '2026-10-23 18:45',
      ref: 'TD-WLT-554920',
      recipient: 'TarabaData Wallet'
    },
    {
      id: 'TRX-98233812',
      type: 'Electricity Bill',
      details: 'IKEDC Prepaid - 45091283741',
      network: 'ikedc',
      amount: 5000,
      status: 'successful',
      date: '2026-10-20 11:05',
      ref: 'TD-ELEC-993021',
      recipient: '45091283741',
      token: '4812-9023-1182-3901-4412'
    },
    {
      id: 'TRX-98233510',
      type: 'Cable Subscription',
      details: 'GOtv Max Package - 2018473920',
      network: 'gotv',
      amount: 4850,
      status: 'failed',
      date: '2026-10-18 16:20',
      ref: 'TD-CBL-002931',
      recipient: '2018473920'
    }
  ]);

  // Network list
  const networks = [
    { id: 'mtn', name: 'MTN', color: 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-900 border-amber-500', badge: 'Active' },
    { id: 'airtel', name: 'Airtel', color: 'bg-rose-600 text-white border-rose-700', badge: 'Active' },
    { id: 'glo', name: 'Glo', color: 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-700', badge: 'Active' },
    { id: '9mobile', name: '9mobile', color: 'bg-lime-700 text-white border-lime-800', badge: 'Active' }
  ];

  // Data plans dictionary
  const dataPlans = {
    mtn: [
      { id: 'm1', size: '500MB', price: 150, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm2', size: '1GB', price: 280, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm3', size: '2GB', price: 560, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm4', size: '3GB', price: 840, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm5', size: '5GB', price: 1400, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm6', size: '10GB', price: 2800, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: 'm7', size: '20GB', price: 5500, validity: '30 Days', type: 'Corporate' }
    ],
    airtel: [
      { id: 'a1', size: '1GB', price: 290, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' },
      { id: 'a2', size: '2GB', price: 580, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' },
      { id: 'a3', size: '5GB', price: 1450, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' },
      { id: 'a4', size: '10GB', price: 2900, validity: '30 Days', type: 'Gifting' }
    ],
    glo: [
      { id: 'g1', size: '1.25GB', price: 275, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' },
      { id: 'g2', size: '2.9GB', price: 550, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' },
      { id: 'g3', size: '7.7GB', price: 1380, validity: '30 Days', type: 'CG' }
    ],
    '9mobile': [
      { id: '91', size: '1GB', price: 250, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: '92', size: '2GB', price: 500, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' },
      { id: '93', size: '5GB', price: 1250, validity: '30 Days', type: 'SME' }
    ]
  };

  // Cable Packages
  const cablePackages = {
    dstv: [
      { id: 'd1', name: 'DStv Padi', price: 3600 },
      { id: 'd2', name: 'DStv Yanga', price: 5100 },
      { id: 'd3', name: 'DStv Confam', price: 9300 },
      { id: 'd4', name: 'DStv Compact', price: 15700 }
    ],
    gotv: [
      { id: 'gt1', name: 'GOtv Smallie', price: 1500 },
      { id: 'gt2', name: 'GOtv Jinja', price: 3300 },
      { id: 'gt3', name: 'GOtv Jolli', price: 4850 },
      { id: 'gt4', name: 'GOtv Max', price: 7200 }
    ],
    startimes: [
      { id: 'st1', name: 'Nova Week', price: 600 },
      { id: 'st2', name: 'Basic Month', price: 3000 },
      { id: 'st3', name: 'Classic Month', price: 5000 }
    ]
  };

  // Helper Toast Alert
  const showToast = (msg) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  // Copy helper
  const copyToClipboard = (text, type) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedAccount(type);
    showToast('Copied to clipboard!');
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedAccount(null), 2000);
  };

  // Validate Cable Smartcard / IUC
  const handleValidateSmartCard = () => {
    if (smartCardNo.length < 8) {
      showToast('Please enter a valid IUC / SmartCard Number');
      return;
    }
    setIsValidating(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsValidating(false);
      setCustomerInfo({
        name: 'MUSA HARUNA TARABA',
        status: 'Active',
        expiry: '2026-11-12'
      });
      showToast('SmartCard Verified Successfully!');
    }, 1200);
  };

  // Validate Electricity Meter Number
  const handleValidateMeter = () => {
    if (meterNo.length < 8) {
      showToast('Please enter a valid 10-13 digit Meter Number');
      return;
    }
    setIsValidating(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsValidating(false);
      setCustomerInfo({
        name: 'AISHATU A. JALINGO',
        address: 'No. 14 Barde Way, Jalingo, Taraba State',
        minPurchase: 1000
      });
      showToast('Meter Validated Successfully!');
    }, 1200);
  };

  // Calculate purchase total
  const getPurchaseAmount = () => {
    if (transactionType === 'data') return selectedPlan?.price || 0;
    if (transactionType === 'airtime') {
      const amt = parseFloat(airtimeAmount) || 0;
      return amt > 0 ? amt * 0.98 : 0; // 2% Discount
    }
    if (transactionType === 'cable') {
      const pkg = cablePackages[cableProvider]?.find(p => p.id === cablePlan);
      return pkg?.price || 0;
    }
    if (transactionType === 'electricity') return parseFloat(electricityAmount) || 0;
    return 0;
  };

  // Initiate Flow with PIN Verification
  const startTransaction = (type) => {
    setTransactionType(type);
    const amount = getPurchaseAmount();

    if (amount <= 0) {
      showToast('Please select a plan or enter a valid amount.');
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'data' && !phoneNumber) {
      showToast('Please enter recipient phone number.');
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'airtime' && !phoneNumber) {
      showToast('Please enter recipient phone number.');
      return;
    }

    if (amount > walletBalance) {
      showToast('Insufficient wallet balance. Please fund your wallet.');
      return;
    }

    setPinInput(['', '', '', '']);
    setPinModal(true);
  };

  // Confirm PIN and Execute Mock Transaction
  const handlePinSubmit = () => {
    const enteredPin = pinInput.join('');
    if (enteredPin.length < 4) {
      showToast('Please enter complete 4-digit PIN');
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      setPinModal(false);

      const amount = getPurchaseAmount();
      const newBal = walletBalance - amount;
      setWalletBalance(newBal);
      
      // Calculate cashback bonus (1% for airtime/data)
      const earnedCashback = amount * 0.01;
      setCashbackBalance(prev => prev + earnedCashback);

      let detailsText = '';
      let refCode = 'TD-' + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000);
      let recipientVal = phoneNumber;
      let tokenVal = null;

      if (transactionType === 'data') {
        detailsText = `${selectedNetwork.toUpperCase()} ${dataType} ${selectedPlan.size} - ${phoneNumber}`;
      } else if (transactionType === 'airtime') {
        detailsText = `${selectedNetwork.toUpperCase()} Airtime ₦${airtimeAmount} - ${phoneNumber}`;
      } else if (transactionType === 'cable') {
        const pkg = cablePackages[cableProvider]?.find(p => p.id === cablePlan);
        detailsText = `${cableProvider.toUpperCase()} (${pkg?.name}) - ${smartCardNo}`;
        recipientVal = smartCardNo;
      } else if (transactionType === 'electricity') {
        detailsText = `${discoProvider.toUpperCase()} (${meterType}) - ${meterNo}`;
        recipientVal = meterNo;
        tokenVal = `${Math.floor(1000+Math.random()*9000)}-${Math.floor(1000+Math.random()*9000)}-${Math.floor(1000+Math.random()*9000)}-${Math.floor(1000+Math.random()*9000)}`;
      }

      const newTx = {
        id: `TRX-${Math.floor(90000000 + Math.random() * 9999999)}`,
        type: transactionType === 'data' ? 'Data Purchase' : 
              transactionType === 'airtime' ? 'Airtime Topup' :
              transactionType === 'cable' ? 'Cable Subscription' : 'Electricity Bill',
        details: detailsText,
        network: selectedNetwork,
        amount: amount,
        status: 'successful',
        date: new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16),
        ref: refCode,
        recipient: recipientVal,
        token: tokenVal
      };

      setTransactions([newTx, ...transactions]);
      setReceiptModal(newTx);
      
      // Reset forms
      setPhoneNumber('');
      setAirtimeAmount('');
      setSmartCardNo('');
      setMeterNo('');
      setElectricityAmount('');
      setCustomerInfo(null);

    }, 1800);
  };

  // Fund Wallet Logic
  const handleFundWallet = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const amt = parseFloat(fundAmount);
    if (!amt || amt < 100) {
      showToast('Minimum deposit is ₦100');
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      setWalletBalance(prev => prev + amt);
      
      const fundTx = {
        id: `TRX-${Math.floor(90000000 + Math.random() * 9999999)}`,
        type: 'Wallet Funding',
        details: paymentMethod === 'bank' ? 'Instant Bank Transfer' : 'Card Gateway Deposit',
        network: 'wallet',
        amount: amt,
        status: 'successful',
        date: new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16),
        ref: 'TD-FUND-' + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000),
        recipient: 'TarabaData Wallet'
      };

      setTransactions([fundTx, ...transactions]);
      setFundWalletModal(false);
      setFundAmount('');
      showToast(`Successfully credited ₦${amt.toLocaleString()} to your wallet!`);
    }, 1500);
  };

  // Filtered transactions list
  const filteredTransactions = transactions.filter(tx => {
    const matchesSearch = tx.details.toLowerCase().includes(txSearch.toLowerCase()) || 
                          tx.ref.toLowerCase().includes(txSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
                          tx.recipient.includes(txSearch);
    if (txFilter === 'all') return matchesSearch;
    if (txFilter === 'data') return matchesSearch && tx.type.includes('Data');
    if (txFilter === 'airtime') return matchesSearch && tx.type.includes('Airtime');
    if (txFilter === 'utility') return matchesSearch && (tx.type.includes('Cable') || tx.type.includes('Electricity'));
    if (txFilter === 'wallet') return matchesSearch && tx.type.includes('Wallet');
    return matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className={`min-h-screen transition-colors duration-200 ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-100' : 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-800'} font-sans pb-20 md:pb-10`}>
      
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 animate-bounce border border-slate-700">
          <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 dark:text-white" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* HEADER NAVBAR */}
      <header className={`sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-md ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white/90 border-slate-200'} border-b px-4 lg:px-8 py-3 transition-colors`}>
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between">
          
          {/* Logo */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}>
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-emerald-600 to-teal-400 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 font-bold text-xl">
              <Wifi className="w-6 h-6 stroke-[2.5]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-xl font-black tracking-tight bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-teal-500 to-cyan-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                TarabaData
              </span>
              <span className="block text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-widest text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase -mt-1">
                VTU & Utilities
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Desktop Navigation Tabs */}
          <nav className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            {[
              { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard' },
              { id: 'buy-data', label: 'Buy Data' },
              { id: 'airtime', label: 'Airtime' },
              { id: 'cable', label: 'Cable TV' },
              { id: 'electricity', label: 'Electricity' },
              { id: 'history', label: 'History' },
            ].map(tab => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md'
                    : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400'
                }`}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {/* User Controls & Quick Fund */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => setFundWalletModal(true)}
              className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 active:scale-95"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Fund Wallet</span>
            </button>

            {/* Dark Mode Toggle */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-amber-400' : 'bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-slate-600'} transition-colors`}
              aria-label="Toggle Theme"
            >
              {darkMode ? <Sun className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Moon className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>

            {/* Notification Bell */}
            <div className="relative">
              <button
                onClick={() => setNotificationsOpen(!notificationsOpen)}
                className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border relative ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-slate-300' : 'bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-slate-600'}`}
              >
                <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping"></span>
                <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
              </button>

              {/* Notification Dropdown */}
              {notificationsOpen && (
                <div className={`absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border p-4 z-50 ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-100' : 'bg-white border-slate-100 text-slate-800'}`}>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 mb-3">
                    <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm">Notifications</h4>
                    <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 cursor-pointer">Mark all read</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/50 flex items-start gap-3">
                      <Gift className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold">Weekend Data Promo!</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Get 10GB MTN Data at ₦2,700 today only.</p>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">10 mins ago</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-start gap-3">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold">Wallet Funded</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Your transfer of ₦10,000 was received.</p>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">2 hours ago</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Profile Avatar */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-teal-500 to-emerald-600 text-white font-semibold flex items-center justify-center text-sm shadow">
                MH
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Mobile Menu Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
              className="md:hidden p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200"
            >
              {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Menu className="w-6 h-6" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Mobile Navigation Menu Dropdown */}
        {mobileMenuOpen && (
          <div className="md:hidden mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {[
              { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: Wallet },
              { id: 'buy-data', label: 'Buy Data', icon: Wifi },
              { id: 'airtime', label: 'Airtime', icon: PhoneCall },
              { id: 'cable', label: 'Cable TV', icon: Tv },
              { id: 'electricity', label: 'Electricity', icon: Zap },
              { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: History },
            ].map(tab => {
              const IconComp = tab.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveTab(tab.id);
                    setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium gap-1 transition-all ${
                    activeTab === tab.id
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <IconComp className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{tab.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      {/* MAIN CONTAINER */}
      <main className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 lg:px-8 pt-6">

        {/* ==================== TAB 1: DASHBOARD ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            
            {/* Balance Overview & Cashback Banner */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              
              {/* Wallet Balance Card */}
              <div className="md:col-span-2 relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl p-6 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-emerald-950 to-slate-900 text-white shadow-xl border border-slate-800">
                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 -mr-16 -mt-16 w-64 h-64 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col justify-between h-full">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> Verified Account
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowBalance(!showBalance)}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                    >
                      {showBalance ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="my-4">
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-1">Available Balance</p>
                    <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                      <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
                        {showBalance ? `₦${walletBalance.toLocaleString('en-NG', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}` : '••••••••'}
                      </h2>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setFundWalletModal(true)}
                      className="flex-1 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-slate-950 font-bold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" /> Fund Wallet
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setTransactionType('data');
                        setActiveTab('buy-data');
                      }}
                      className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm border border-slate-700 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <Wifi className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> Quick Data
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Cashback & Rewards Card */}
              <div className={`rounded-3xl p-6 border flex flex-col justify-between ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Cashback Points
                    </span>
                    <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500">
                      <Gift className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                    ₦{cashbackBalance.toFixed(2)}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                    Earn 1% bonus on every airtime and data purchase automatically.
                  </p>
                </div>
                
                <button
                  onClick={() => showToast('Cashback converted to main balance!')}
                  className="mt-4 w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-500/10 text-xs font-semibold transition-all"
                >
                  Withdraw to Wallet
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Network Status Indicator */}
            <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                  Live Network Server Status
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Auto-Refreshed</span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                {networks.map(net => (
                  <div key={net.id} className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-700/60' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-100'}`}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${net.id === 'mtn' ? 'bg-amber-400' : net.id === 'airtel' ? 'bg-rose-500' : net.id === 'glo' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-lime-600'}`}></div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase">{net.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      99.9%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Action Grid */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Services & Utilities
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
                {[
                  { id: 'buy-data', label: 'Buy Data', icon: Wifi, color: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10', desc: 'Cheap SME / Gifting' },
                  { id: 'airtime', label: 'Airtime Topup', icon: PhoneCall, color: 'text-blue-500 bg-blue-500/10', desc: 'Instant 2% Discount' },
                  { id: 'cable', label: 'Cable TV', icon: Tv, color: 'text-purple-500 bg-purple-500/10', desc: 'DStv, GOtv, Startimes' },
                  { id: 'electricity', label: 'Electricity', icon: Zap, color: 'text-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10', desc: 'Prepaid Tokens' },
                  { id: 'fund', label: 'Fund Wallet', icon: Wallet, color: 'text-teal-500 bg-teal-500/10', desc: 'Instant Bank Deposit', action: () => setFundWalletModal(true) },
                ].map((act, i) => {
                  const IconComp = act.icon;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (act.action) act.action();
                        else setActiveTab(act.id);
                      }}
                      className={`group p-4 rounded-2xl border cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg ${
                        darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 hover:border-emerald-500/50' : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-emerald-500/50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-3 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110 ${act.color}`}>
                        <IconComp className="w-6 h-6" />
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{act.label}</h4>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{act.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Special Offers Banner / Carousel */}
            <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-600 to-emerald-700 text-white p-6 shadow-xl">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 relative z-10">
                <div className="space-y-2 text-center sm:text-left">
                  <span className="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/20 text-xs font-bold backdrop-blur-md">
                    🔥 Hot Deal of the Day
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black">
                    Get 10GB MTN Corporate Data for ₦2,800
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-teal-100 max-w-md">
                    Valid for 30 Days. Works on 4G/5G Routers, Android & iPhones without speed throttling.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedNetwork('mtn');
                    setActiveTab('buy-data');
                  }}
                  className="bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-950 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all"
                >
                  Buy Now
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Recent Transactions Section */}
            <div className={`rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} p-6 shadow-sm`}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <History className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                  Recent Transactions
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  View All <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {transactions.slice(0, 4).map(tx => (
                  <div
                    key={tx.id}
                    onClick={() => setReceiptModal(tx)}
                    className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 px-2 rounded-xl transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white ${
                        tx.type.includes('Data') ? 'bg-emerald-600' :
                        tx.type.includes('Airtime') ? 'bg-blue-600' :
                        tx.type.includes('Wallet') ? 'bg-teal-600' : 'bg-amber-600'
                      }`}>
                        {tx.type.includes('Data') && <Wifi className="w-5 h-5" />}
                        {tx.type.includes('Airtime') && <PhoneCall className="w-5 h-5" />}
                        {tx.type.includes('Wallet') && <ArrowDownLeft className="w-5 h-5" />}
                        {(tx.type.includes('Cable') || tx.type.includes('Electricity')) && <Zap className="w-5 h-5" />}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{tx.details}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{tx.date}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                        ₦{tx.amount.toLocaleString()}
                      </p>
                      <span className={`inline-block text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                        tx.status === 'successful' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' :
                        tx.status === 'pending' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500' :
                        'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                      }`}>
                        {tx.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================== TAB 2: BUY DATA ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'buy-data' && (
          <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            <div className={`p-6 rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                <Wifi className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500" />
                Purchase Internet Data
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
                Select network, plan and enter mobile line to send data instantly.
              </p>

              {/* Network Selector */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  1. Select Network
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                  {networks.map(net => (
                    <button
                      key={net.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedNetwork(net.id);
                        setSelectedPlan(null);
                      }}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                        selectedNetwork === net.id
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${net.color} flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold shadow`}>
                        {net.name[0]}
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold">{net.name}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Data Type Selector */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  2. Select Type
                </label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {['SME', 'Gifting', 'Corporate Gifting'].map(type => (
                    <button
                      key={type}
                      onClick={() => setDataType(type)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                        dataType === type
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:border-emerald-600'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {type}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Data Plan List */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  3. Select Bundle Plan
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  {dataPlans[selectedNetwork]?.map(plan => (
                    <div
                      key={plan.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedPlan(plan)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        selectedPlan?.id === plan.id
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 block">{plan.type}</span>
                      <p className="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{plan.size}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">₦{plan.price}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{plan.validity}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Phone Number Input */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  4. Recipient Phone Number
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    placeholder="e.g. 08031234567"
                    value={phoneNumber}
                    onChange={(e) => setPhoneNumber(e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none transition-all ${
                      darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white focus:border-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 focus:border-emerald-500'
                    }`}
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setPhoneNumber('08031234567')}
                    className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
                  >
                    Use Saved
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Order Summary */}
              {selectedPlan && (
                <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/5 border border-emerald-500/20 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Selected Bundle:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold">{selectedNetwork.toUpperCase()} {selectedPlan.size} ({selectedPlan.type})</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Recipient:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold">{phoneNumber || 'Not provided'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-sm pt-2 border-t border-emerald-500/20 font-bold">
                    <span>Total Amount:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">₦{selectedPlan.price}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                onClick={() => startTransaction('data')}
                disabled={!selectedPlan || !phoneNumber}
                className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20 active:scale-98"
              >
                Proceed to Payment
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================== TAB 3: AIRTIME ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'airtime' && (
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            <div className={`p-6 rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                <PhoneCall className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" />
                Airtime Top-up (VTU)
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
                Enjoy instant 2% discount on all airtime top-ups.
              </p>

              {/* Network Picker */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Network</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                  {networks.map(net => (
                    <button
                      key={net.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedNetwork(net.id)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                        selectedNetwork === net.id
                          ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 ring-2 ring-blue-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${net.color} flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold shadow`}>
                        {net.name[0]}
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold">{net.name}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Amount Input */}
              <div className="mb-4">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Amount (₦)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  placeholder="e.g. 1000"
                  value={airtimeAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setAirtimeAmount(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none transition-all ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white focus:border-blue-500' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 focus:border-blue-500'
                  }`}
                />
                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
                  {[200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000].map(amt => (
                    <button
                      key={amt}
                      onClick={() => setAirtimeAmount(amt.toString())}
                      className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
                    >
                      ₦{amt}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Phone Input */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Phone Number</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  placeholder="e.g. 08029876543"
                  value={phoneNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhoneNumber(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                  }`}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Discount Calculator Banner */}
              {airtimeAmount > 0 && (
                <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500 block">Payable Amount (2% Off):</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                      ₦{(parseFloat(airtimeAmount) * 0.98).toFixed(2)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded bg-blue-500 text-white">You save ₦{(parseFloat(airtimeAmount) * 0.02).toFixed(2)}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                onClick={() => startTransaction('airtime')}
                disabled={!airtimeAmount || !phoneNumber}
                className="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20"
              >
                Buy Airtime Now
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================== TAB 4: CABLE TV ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'cable' && (
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            <div className={`p-6 rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                <Tv className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-500" />
                Cable TV Subscription
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
                Instant decoder activation for DStv, GOtv, and StarTimes.
              </p>

              {/* Cable Provider Picker */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Provider</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  {[
                    { id: 'dstv', name: 'DStv' },
                    { id: 'gotv', name: 'GOtv' },
                    { id: 'startimes', name: 'StarTimes' }
                  ].map(p => (
                    <button
                      key={p.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setCableProvider(p.id);
                        setCablePlan('');
                        setCustomerInfo(null);
                      }}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
                        cableProvider === p.id
                          ? 'border-purple-500 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 ring-2 ring-purple-500/20'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {p.name}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Smartcard / IUC Input */}
              <div className="mb-4">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Smartcard / IUC Number</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Enter IUC Number"
                    value={smartCardNo}
                    onChange={(e) => setSmartCardNo(e.target.value)}
                    className={`flex-1 p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                      darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleValidateSmartCard}
                    disabled={isValidating}
                    className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 rounded-xl transition-all shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center"
                  >
                    {isValidating ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : 'Verify'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Verified Customer Card */}
              {customerInfo && (
                <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/20 text-xs space-y-1">
                  <p className="font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">Customer Details Verified</p>
                  <p><span className="text-slate-500">Name:</span> {customerInfo.name}</p>
                  <p><span className="text-slate-500">Current Expiry:</span> {customerInfo.expiry}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Cable Package List */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Package Plan</label>
                <select
                  value={cablePlan}
                  onChange={(e) => setCablePlan(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Select Package --</option>
                  {cablePackages[cableProvider]?.map(pkg => (
                    <option key={pkg.id} value={pkg.id}>
                      {pkg.name} - ₦{pkg.price.toLocaleString()}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => startTransaction('cable')}
                disabled={!smartCardNo || !cablePlan}
                className="w-full bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/20"
              >
                Pay Cable Subscription
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================== TAB 5: ELECTRICITY ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'electricity' && (
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            <div className={`p-6 rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                <Zap className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
                Electricity Bill Payment
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
                Buy prepaid meter tokens or pay postpaid electricity bills instantly.
              </p>

              {/* Disco Selection */}
              <div className="mb-4">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Electricity Company (Disco)</label>
                <select
                  value={discoProvider}
                  onChange={(e) => setDiscoProvider(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <option value="ikedc">Ikeja Electric (IKEDC)</option>
                  <option value="ekedc">Eko Electric (EKEDC)</option>
                  <option value="aedc">Abuja Electric (AEDC)</option>
                  <option value="ibedc">Ibadan Electric (IBEDC)</option>
                  <option value="jedc">Jos Electric (JEDC)</option>
                  <option value="kedco">Kano Electric (KEDCO)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Meter Type Selector */}
              <div className="mb-4">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Meter Type</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {['prepaid', 'postpaid'].map(t => (
                    <button
                      key={t}
                      onClick={() => setMeterType(t)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                        meterType === t
                          ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 border-amber-500'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {t}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Meter Number Validation */}
              <div className="mb-4">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Meter Number</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Enter 10-13 digit Meter No."
                    value={meterNo}
                    onChange={(e) => setMeterNo(e.target.value)}
                    className={`flex-1 p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                      darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleValidateMeter}
                    disabled={isValidating}
                    className="bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 text-xs font-bold px-4 rounded-xl transition-all shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center"
                  >
                    {isValidating ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : 'Verify'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Verified Customer Info */}
              {customerInfo && customerInfo.address && (
                <div className="mb-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-xs space-y-1">
                  <p className="font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Meter Info Verified</p>
                  <p><span className="text-slate-500">Account Name:</span> {customerInfo.name}</p>
                  <p><span className="text-slate-500">Address:</span> {customerInfo.address}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Amount Input */}
              <div className="mb-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Amount (₦)</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  placeholder="Min ₦1,000"
                  value={electricityAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setElectricityAmount(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                  }`}
                />
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => startTransaction('electricity')}
                disabled={!meterNo || !electricityAmount}
                className="w-full bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20"
              >
                Generate Token / Pay Bill
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================== TAB 6: HISTORY ==================== */}
        {activeTab === 'history' && (
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className={`p-6 rounded-3xl border ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'} shadow-sm`}>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <History className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500" />
                    Transaction History & Receipts
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Search and filter your recent transactions or download receipts.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Filter Tabs */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-xl overflow-x-auto">
                  {['all', 'data', 'airtime', 'utility', 'wallet'].map(filter => (
                    <button
                      key={filter}
                      onClick={() => setTxFilter(filter)}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg capitalize transition-all shrink-0 ${
                        txFilter === filter
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-500'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {filter}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Search Box */}
              <div className="relative mb-6">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search by details, reference ID, or phone number..."
                  value={txSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setTxSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className={`w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                  }`}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Transactions Table */}
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Type</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Description</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Reference</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Amount</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2">Status</th>
                      <th className="pb-3 px-2 text-right">Action</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 text-xs">
                    {filteredTransactions.map(tx => (
                      <tr key={tx.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-bold">{tx.type}</td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                          <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{tx.details}</p>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{tx.date}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px]">{tx.ref}</td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                          ₦{tx.amount.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2">
                          <span className={`inline-block text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                            tx.status === 'successful' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' :
                            tx.status === 'pending' ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500'
                          }`}>
                            {tx.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-2 text-right">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setReceiptModal(tx)}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-semibold"
                          >
                            Receipt
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>

                {filteredTransactions.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400">
                    <History className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
                    <p className="text-sm">No transactions found matching your filter.</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

      </main>

      {/* ==================== FUND WALLET MODAL ==================== */}
      {fundWalletModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-2xl relative ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-100' : 'bg-white border-slate-100 text-slate-800'}`}>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFundWalletModal(false)}
              className="absolute top-5 right-5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
              <PlusCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" /> Fund Your TarabaData Wallet
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-4">
              Instant automated funding via dedicated bank transfer or debit card.
            </p>

            {/* Funding Method Tabs */}
            <div className="flex gap-2 p-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl mb-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => setPaymentMethod('bank')}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  paymentMethod === 'bank' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                }`}
              >
                Automated Bank Accounts
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setPaymentMethod('card')}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  paymentMethod === 'card' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                }`}
              >
                Card Gateway
              </button>
            </div>

            {paymentMethod === 'bank' ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                  Transfer to any of your dedicated account numbers below for instant 24/7 wallet top-up:
                </p>

                {/* Moniepoint Account Card */}
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Moniepoint MFB</span>
                    <p className="text-sm font-extrabold tracking-wider font-mono">6502938102</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">TarabaData - Musa Haruna</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard('6502938102', 'moniepoint')}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {copiedAccount === 'moniepoint' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Wema Bank Card */}
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Wema Bank</span>
                    <p className="text-sm font-extrabold tracking-wider font-mono">9018239481</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">TarabaData - Musa Haruna</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard('9018239481', 'wema')}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {copiedAccount === 'wema' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 p-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>Automated funding usually credits within 30 seconds. 1.0% stamp duty charge applies.</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleFundWallet} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Amount to Deposit (₦)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    placeholder="e.g. 5000"
                    value={fundAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setFundAmount(e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                      darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Promo / Coupon Code (Optional)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Enter Promo Code"
                    value={promoCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setPromoCode(e.target.value)}
                    className={`w-full p-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-semibold outline-none ${
                      darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isProcessing}
                  className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  {isProcessing ? <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : 'Pay via Paystack / Flutterwave'}
                </button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================== PIN AUTHORIZATION MODAL ==================== */}
      {pinModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-2xl relative text-center ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-100' : 'bg-white border-slate-100 text-slate-800'}`}>
            <button
              onClick={() => setPinModal(false)}
              className="absolute top-5 right-5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1">Authorize Transaction</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
              Enter your 4-digit transaction PIN to confirm ₦{getPurchaseAmount().toLocaleString()} debit.
            </p>

            {/* PIN Inputs */}
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 mb-6">
              {[0, 1, 2, 3].map(idx => (
                <input
                  key={idx}
                  id={`pin-${idx}`}
                  type="password"
                  maxLength={1}
                  value={pinInput[idx]}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const val = e.target.value;
                    const newPin = [...pinInput];
                    newPin[idx] = val;
                    setPinInput(newPin);

                    if (val && idx < 3) {
                      const nextInput = document.getElementById(`pin-${idx + 1}`);
                      if (nextInput) nextInput.focus();
                    }
                  }}
                  className={`w-12 h-12 text-center text-xl font-bold rounded-xl border outline-none ${
                    darkMode ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white focus:border-emerald-500' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:border-emerald-500'
                  }`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handlePinSubmit}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              {isProcessing ? <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : 'Confirm & Send'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================== TRANSACTION RECEIPT MODAL ==================== */}
      {receiptModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-2xl relative ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-slate-100' : 'bg-white border-slate-100 text-slate-800'}`}>
            
            <button
              onClick={() => setReceiptModal(null)}
              className="absolute top-5 right-5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Receipt Header */}
            <div className="text-center pb-6 border-b border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2">
                <CheckCircle className="w-7 h-7" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Transaction Successful</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{receiptModal.date}</p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold mt-3">₦{receiptModal.amount.toLocaleString()}</p>
            </div>

            {/* Details Breakdown */}
            <div className="py-4 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Transaction Type</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{receiptModal.type}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Description</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{receiptModal.details}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Recipient / Account</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{receiptModal.recipient}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Reference Ref</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">{receiptModal.ref}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Status</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-500 uppercase">{receiptModal.status}</span>
              </div>

              {/* Display Generated Token for Electricity */}
              {receiptModal.token && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-center">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold uppercase block">Electricity Prepaid Token</span>
                  <p className="text-base font-mono font-black text-amber-500 tracking-wider my-1">{receiptModal.token}</p>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard(receiptModal.token, 'token')}
                    className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 underline hover:text-slate-800"
                  >
                    Copy Token
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => showToast('Receipt Downloaded!')}
                className="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Download className="w-4 h-4" /> Download PDF
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => showToast('Receipt Link Copied to Share')}
                className="flex-1 py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Share Receipt
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MOBILE BOTTOM NAVIGATION BAR */}
      <div className={`md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 border-t ${darkMode ? 'bg-slate-900/95 border-slate-800' : 'bg-white/95 border-slate-200'} backdrop-blur-md px-2 py-2`}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1">
          {[
            { id: 'dashboard', label: 'Home', icon: Wallet },
            { id: 'buy-data', label: 'Data', icon: Wifi },
            { id: 'airtime', label: 'Airtime', icon: PhoneCall },
            { id: 'cable', label: 'Bills', icon: Tv },
            { id: 'history', label: 'History', icon: History },
          ].map(item => {
            const IconComp = item.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(item.id)}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                  activeTab === item.id
                    ? 'text-emerald-500 font-bold'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600'
                }`}
              >
                <IconComp className="w-5 h-5 mb-0.5" />
                <span className="text-[10px]">{item.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
